verdict.rationale: Importing mail history and contacts is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack does not document any Outlook import feature. The Graph mail API primitives (creating drafts, synchronizing folders) are developer building blocks, not an import capability. The community readpst/.pst conversion note describes moving data out of Outlook into another client, the opposite direction.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can import my complete mail history and contacts from my old provider or client
